candidates.evidence: The installed Krea2 Control LoRA accepts depth, canny, pose, lineart, and normal control images, but it does not consume a character identity embedding or lock facial or authored-design identity.

candidates.productionUse: May not unlock canonical characters, protagonist portraits, or CG. Do not repeat the same single-reference recipe as prompt or strength tuning.

candidates.evidence: A complete local FLUX Kontext edit workflow and weights are installed, but it is a FLUX architecture and cannot load the mandatory Krea2/Qwen six-LoRA production chain.
candidates.productionUse: Not a patch for this Krea2 baseline; requires an independent fidelity, style, and release audit before any separate use.

candidates.evidence: Wan Stand-In/VACE and ConsisID have no local inference weights. ReActor/InsightFace references are video post-processing and missing their expected model files.

decision: Do not submit another character or CG probe until a materially different local identity/control mechanism with documented Krea2 compatibility, installed weights or nodes, and an auditable six-LoRA-compatible wiring plan is available. Krea2Edit, Krea2 depth control, and Krea Reference V10 have each been tested or bounded and cannot unlock canonical character production.
